mandatoryFindings.title: Failed, empty or inconsistent resident observations can still become quiet
counterexamples: Actual nested bounded_capture accepts global ps exit1/empty; actual boundary then accepts resident Tinypool PID20 present in full table
Empty global comm census also accepts with synthetic exit0
Neutral-argv resident whose fake actual cwd is under W is skipped after lsof cwd exit1/empty
Node present in later comm census but absent from earlier table is silently skipped
mandatoryFindings.correction: Use command-specific return-code/completeness rules. Global census must succeed with complete well-formed nonempty data. Missing/failed per-candidate identity/cwd or cross-snapshot mismatch is UNKNOWN/sticky HOLD unless exact scoped identity facts prove the case; never treat failed lookup/disappearance as unrelated. Apply through native monitor, boundary, final, gate and postclose. Preserve verified unrelated/inherited Node and sampled limits without signals/global waits. Extend actual-function pure regressions for all cases.
mandatoryFindings.boundQualification: The new10s bounded_capture covers comm/cwd calls; imported table/identity still call the old capture without timeout. Ensure actual candidate observation paths honor the declared bounds or explicitly narrow that claim; do not claim a fixed phase deadline while an unbounded observation can stall it.

mandatoryFindings.title: Root/ancestor links and unchecked copy destinations can escape owned custody before checks
counterexamples: Actual chart_guard and workspace_guard(original) both accept a symlink copied-chart root that serves expected22 original target files
install-fixed copyfile then follows that root/ancestor into the real helper before post-source checks
Actual final_facts accepts a dedicated-archive root link when its target preserves recorded child identities
Report copyfile has no exclusive/no-follow destination creation; an existing destination link can redirect the write
mandatoryFindings.correction: Before every governed read/traversal/create/replace/copy/archive, validate and retain trusted root/parent identities and effective custody. Reject substituted chart/archive/preparation/output roots or unapproved descendants; bind archive root identities in the receipt/final proof. Use anchored/no-follow/exclusive destination operations, including copied report outputs; checking damage afterward is insufficient. Cover make_copy, helper install, inventories/archive sources and destinations, and final/gate/postclose paths. Preserve explicitly authorized dependency-entry and approved canonical alias handling; no hostile same-UID or new general execution framework claim.
mandatoryFindings.regressions: Add fully injected actual-function negatives for top chart/archive root, parent directory, leaf and dangling-link substitutions and destination overwrite; prove denial before any traversal/write callback. Add valid regular-tree and authorized dependency-link controls.
